scenario: LRST.3.2's per-entity restart compiles: `after 5_min as m.target_light:` (LRST.1.1) keys on a slot of the pattern binding, a non-nullable `String` key slot (LRST.1.4: an equatable scalar; LRST.1.5: non-nullable). PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: no per-entity supersedure is run. LRST.3.2 is an example, so the vector links the clauses that make it legal.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    target_light: String key
    state: String mutable

rule motion_light:
    Motion m where m.state == "on"
->
    log info "on"
    after 5_min as m.target_light:
        log info "timed out"
